_doc: Samurai Shodown II victim postures (export_bm.VICTIM_POSES['samsho2'], the vocabulary of tools/kof96/victim_poses98.json: posture + angle, ROM sprites face left, 0 upright, 90 horizontal head toward the facing side, 180 head down). Keys 'anim.step' of the thrown animations of handlers_ss2.throw (the victim's class 5 entries, in the thrower's own frames): Haohmaru's slash throw 508, kick throw 510 then 470, Genjuro's throw 514 (508 + 6: Haohmaru thrown by Genjuro); the flight 220 and lying 222 play the brawler's knockdown animations. Read by eye from the frames (sheet_ss2.py 0 508,510,470 / 12 514).
